# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph and Vulkan resilience**

## Highlights

Upcoming fixes harden mask-filtered glyph rendering and Imagination Vulkan allocation failure handling. These same-milestone native fixes leave package versions and the managed API unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Mask-filtered glyphs handle changing scaler output** — Rendering uses the reloaded glyph's path, format and bounds when successive font-scaler loads differ. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and clipped embossed masks retain the correct plane strides. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Imagination Vulkan allocation failures avoid unsafe pool destruction** — Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory allocation errors on Imagination drivers, where destroying the pool can trigger a driver failure. Graphite also stops allocating through the abandoned handle; other vendors and errors are unaffected. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
